title: What Matters in Orchestrating Robot Policies: A Systematic Study of Hierarchical VLA Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.10267v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hierarchical vision-language-action (Hi-VLA) systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for complex robot manipulation, by using high-level VLM planners to decompose tasks into language subgoals executed by low-level VLA controllers. Despite recent empirical progress, there is a lack of unified design principles for these systems: existing Hi-VLA systems differ in how they choose and connect planners, controllers, mechanisms to switch between the two, and how observations and memory are represented in the planner. In this paper, we present a systematic study of Hi-VLA design for robot manipulation. We unify representative Hi-VLA agents under an options-style control framework and benchmark core design choices across short-horizon, long-horizon, and reasoning-intensive tasks. Our analysis distills practical principles for building Hi-VLA systems, showing how model choices and interface mechanisms jointly shape performance. App

translated_title: 机器人策略编排中什么最重要：分层VLA智能体的系统性研究
translated_abstract: 分层视觉-语言-动作（Hi-VLA）系统已成为复杂机器人操作领域一种有前景的范式，其通过高层VLM规划器将任务分解为语言子目标，再由低层VLA控制器执行。尽管近期已有实证进展，但这些系统缺乏统一的设计原则：现有的Hi-VLA系统在如何选择和连接规划器与控制器、两者之间的切换机制、以及规划器中观测和记忆的表示方式等方面存在差异。本文对机器人操作的Hi-VLA设计进行了系统性研究。我们将代表性的Hi-VLA智能体统一到选项式控制框架下，并在短时程、长时程和推理密集型任务上对核心设计选择进行基准测试。我们的分析提炼出了构建Hi-VLA系统的实用原则，展示了模型选择与接口机制如何共同决定系统性能。
tldr: 本文对分层视觉-语言-动作（Hi-VLA）机器人系统进行了系统性研究，将代表性智能体统一到选项式控制框架下并在多种任务上基准测试核心设计选择，从中提炼出规划器、控制器与切换机制的实用设计原则。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic study of hierarchical VLA (Hi-VLA) agents for robot manipulation, unifying representative systems under an options-style control framework and benchmarking core design choices across diverse tasks to distill practical principles for building effective Hi-VLA systems.
